name: name-digits-symbols-and-upper-case
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.14 (six-bit armor): payload characters 0-9 (0..9), :;<=>?@ (10..16), A and W (17, 39), ` (40); s1 reads values 0..31 as @.._ and 32..63 as themselves; the leading @ is kept. Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program.
